name: c22-priya-phone
prompt: Photorealistic cinematic live action, exactly as in the image: in the morning office, the woman in the navy pinstripe kurta reads the app on her phone, her eyes moving down the screen; she scrolls once with her thumb, the screen's content sliding up a little and settling, and she nods very slightly. The camera holds nearly still with a very slow drift to the right; the phone's screen stays fully visible and sharp. Every face, hand and arm keeps its form; no extra limbs appear and none vanish; nobody's face changes. The printed Munchly product labels on the cartons (the maroon band, the batch and best-before boxes, the barcode and the QR code) and the Munchly packets stay exactly as they are, crisp and legible, and never change; the app screen on the phone stays exactly as it is, sharp and legible, and never changes to anything else. No other text, letters, logos or lettering appear anywhere. Natural light, 35 mm, shallow depth of field, no handheld shake.
negative_prompt: text, lettering, logo, brand name, label, watermark, subtitles, children
